title: Young Hitler and Lanz von Liebenfels's Order of the New Templars

tellings.quote: It said that he actually visited Lans van Libfels in his office.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret societies, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about Lanz von Liebenfels, a writer in Vienna who led a mystical group called the Order of the New Templars. Drawing on his book Unholy Alliance, Levenda says a source stated that a young Adolf Hitler visited Lanz in his office in the early 1900s. If true, it would tie Hitler to occult ideas before he came to power.
